gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads big and friendly, its tall lowercase leaving generous openings in every curve. Redux sprawls above it with wide spacing and display swagger.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Redux spaces its letters wide and swings into every curve with a visible entrance, big and confident. And Noto Sans Sundanese stays low and tight, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Approachable is the first thing Noto Sans Sunuwar says, its curves leaving daylight like a rope's open bight beneath short ascender stems. Redux is its loud, wide-spaced opposite.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Redux has a soft, hand-inked modulation in its wide-spaced, enlarged lowercase. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri brings short ascenders and a tall x-height, so it does the quiet, steady reading while the heading takes the attention.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads round and full, like blown glass bulbs. Redux adds wide-spaced display letters with thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones, giving the page a confident top and an easygoing body.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eas: Approachable describes Noto Sans Syriac Eastern, with tall lowercase set against small caps and curve endings that never crowd. And Redux, wide-spaced and subtly modulated, makes paragraphs under it feel easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wes: Redux makes a big visible entrance into every curve, spread across wide letter spacing and an enlarged lowercase. Noto Sans Syriac Western is a plain sans with terminals held far back.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog has a dense, middle-heavy texture. Redux, with lightly engraved brass contrast and wide spacing, gives that tight, generous-curved body a bold lead to follow down the page.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Soft, wide and brushy, Redux leads with a lightly pressed thick-thin shift. Noto Sans Tai Le follows with tapering ink strokes and barely any step up to capitals, so paragraphs glide along.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-takri: Wide, brash and enlarged, Redux commands the top. Noto Sans Takri is a sans with high-waisted lowercase and open curves, and if the heading shrinks, its pinched joins and wide spacing lose their punch.
